title: 马斯克如何将政府运作游戏化(1)
desc: 马斯克如何将政府运作游戏化(1)

paragraphs.en: In 2025, when Elon Musk joined the government as the de facto head of something called the "department of government efficiency", he declared that governments were poorly configured "big dumb machines".
paragraphs.zh: 2025年，当埃隆·马斯克以"政府效率部"实际负责人的身份加入政府时，他宣称政府是配置不当的"大型愚蠢机器"。

paragraphs.en: To the senator Ted Cruz, he explained that "the only way to reconcile the databases and get rid of waste and fraud is to actually look at the computers".
paragraphs.zh: 他对参议员特德·克鲁兹解释道：“要使这些数据库实现对接并消除浪费与欺诈现象，唯一的办法就是亲自去查看那些电脑。”

paragraphs.en: Muskism came to Washington soaked in memes, adolescent boasts and sadistic victory dances over mass firings.
paragraphs.zh: 马斯克主义在华盛顿盛行后，到处充斥着各种表情包、青少年式的自吹自擂以及因大规模裁员而引发的残忍胜利庆祝场面。

paragraphs.en: Leading a team of teenage coders and mid-level managers drawn from his suite of companies, Musk aimed to enter the codebase and rewrite regulations and budget lines from within.
paragraphs.zh: 马斯克带领着一支由旗下各公司中的年轻程序员和中层管理人员组成的团队，旨在进入代码系统内部，从内部对规章制度和预算项目进行修改。

paragraphs.en: He would drag the paper-pushing bureaucracy kicking and screaming into the digital 21st century, scanning the contents of cavernous rooms of filing cabinets and feeding the data into a single interoperable system.
paragraphs.zh: 他将迫使那些墨守成规、不愿变革的官僚机构在痛苦挣扎中迈入 21 世纪的数字化时代，扫描那些堆积如山的文件柜内的资料，并将数据导入一个统一的可互操作的系统中。

paragraphs.en: The undertaking combined features of private equity-led restructuring with startup management, shot through with the sensibility of gaming and rightwing culture war.
paragraphs.zh: 这项事业将私募股权主导的重组特点与初创企业管理相结合，还充斥着游戏元素和右翼文化战争意识。

paragraphs.en: To succeed, he would need "God mode", an overview of the whole.
paragraphs.zh: 要想成功，他需要“上帝视角”，即对全局的俯瞰。

paragraphs.en: If the mandate of Doge was to "modernise federal technology and software to maximise governmental efficiency and productivity", in the words of the executive order that launched the initiative on 20 January 2025, the reality was a strengthening of the state's surveillance capacities.
paragraphs.zh: 如果按照 2025 年 1 月 20 日启动该计划的行政命令所言，政府效率部的使命是“通过现代化联邦技术与软件来最大限度地提高政府效率和生产力”，那么实际情况却是国家的监控能力得到了加强。

paragraphs.en: Over time, Musk had become convinced that the real bugs in the code were people, especially the non-white illegal immigrants whom he saw as pawns in a liberal scheme to corrupt democracy and beneficiaries of what he called "suicidal empathy".
paragraphs.zh: 随着时间的推移，马斯克逐渐坚信，代码里真正的问题在于人，尤其是那些非白人非法移民，他认为这些人是自由派破坏民主计划中的棋子，也是他所谓“自杀式同理心”的受益者。

paragraphs.en: He understood empathy itself in coding terms. It was an "exploit" or a software vulnerability against which the system architecture needed to be hardened.
paragraphs.zh: 他从编程的角度来理解同理心。同理心是一种“漏洞”或软件缺陷，系统架构需要对此加以强化。

paragraphs.en: Musk's office featured a gaming rig complete with an oversized curved screen, and the Doge website had a leaderboard for tallying cuts in real time.
paragraphs.zh: 马斯克的办公室里有一套配备超大曲面屏幕的游戏装备，并且政府效率部网站还有一个用于实时统计分成的排行榜。

paragraphs.en: But beneath the jokes and cosplay lay a serious conviction.
paragraphs.zh: 但在玩笑和角色扮演的背后，是一种严肃的信念。

paragraphs.en: If the state was just a database, then inefficiency came from bad data: undocumented foreigners, ghost employees, even "vampires" collecting social security.
paragraphs.zh: 如果国家只是一个数据库，那么低效就源于糟糕的数据：例如没有合法身份的外国人、吃空饷的员工，甚至还有那些领取社会福利却实际上并不存在的人。

paragraphs.en: These were bugs in the codebase, irregularities to be traced, quarantined and purged. Musk had revamped and retrained Twitter into X.
paragraphs.zh: 这些都是代码库中的漏洞，是需要追踪、隔离并清除的异常情况。马斯克已将推特改造成了X平台，并对其进行了重新调整。

paragraphs.en: To him, the US state was just another system – a glitchy dataset to be scrubbed and optimised.  Call it StateX.
paragraphs.zh: 对他来说，美国政府体制不过是另一种体系——一个需要清理和优化的有问题的数据集。不妨称之为“政府体制X”。

paragraphs.en: Doge marked a new stage in Musk's relationship to government.
paragraphs.zh: 政府效率部标志着马斯克与政府关系进入了一个新阶段。

paragraphs.en: His companies had always fed on public subsidies and contracts, but now he stepped inside the state itself. He did so under the banner of a meme.
paragraphs.zh: 他的公司一直靠公共补贴和合同生存，但现在他直接进入了政府体系。而他这么做，是打着某种理念的旗号。

paragraphs.en: Doge owed its name to the popular Shiba Inu meme, as well as to the memecoin it inspired.
paragraphs.zh: 政府效率部的名字源于流行的柴犬表情包，以及它所启发的表情包币——狗狗币。

paragraphs.en: Musk called himself the "Dogefather" and used a cartoon dog as Doge's first logo. Musk revelled in the absurdity.
paragraphs.zh: 马斯克称自己为“狗狗币教父”，并使用一只卡通狗作为狗狗币的首个标志。马斯克沉醉于这种荒诞之中。

paragraphs.en: "Doge started out as a meme," he mused in February 2025. "Now it's real. Isn't that crazy?"
paragraphs.zh: “狗狗币最初只是个网络流行语，”他在 2025 年 2 月若有所思地说道，“如今它已经成为现实了。这难道不令人惊讶吗？”

paragraphs.en: To explain the project, Musk turned to one of his favourite movies, Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan.
paragraphs.zh: 为了解释这个项目，马斯克提到了他最喜欢的电影之一《星际迷航2：可汗之怒》。

paragraphs.en: In the 1982 film, Captain Kirk wins an unwinnable training simulation called the Kobayashi Maru by reprogramming it. Doge, Musk said, took the same approach.
paragraphs.zh: 在 1982 年的那部电影中，柯克船长通过重新编程成功赢得了一场看似无法获胜的训练模拟游戏，即“小田原演习”。马斯克表示，狗狗币也采用了同样的方法。

paragraphs.en: Shortly after launching Doge, he explained that "the only way to achieve success is to reprogram the matrix such that success is one of the possible outcomes. That's what we're doing."
paragraphs.zh: 在推出狗狗币后不久，他解释道：“取得成功的唯一途径就是对矩阵进行重新编程，让成功成为可能的结果之一。这就是我们正在做的事情。”

paragraphs.en: Texting a friend after his first campaign appearance with Trump, he reiterated his reasoning: "Tomorrow we unleash the anomaly in the matrix."
paragraphs.zh: 在朋友首次与特朗普一同参加竞选活动后，他给朋友发消息，再次重申了自己的理由：“明天我们将揭开这个矩阵中的神秘真相。”

paragraphs.en: Musk had already defied the logic of the automotive and aerospace industries by disrupting the incumbents: "SpaceX is an anomaly in the matrix," he tweeted. Why couldn't he do the same in government?
paragraphs.zh: 马斯克此前已经通过挑战行业内的老牌企业，打破了汽车和航空航天行业的常规逻辑。他在推特上写道：“太空探索技术公司是行业格局中的一个异类。”那他为何不能在政府领域也做到同样的事呢？

paragraphs.en: It might even be fun – beating a game on easy mode.
paragraphs.zh: 在简单模式下通关游戏，这甚至可能会很有趣。

paragraphs.en: When he posted a picture of his Doge office with the gaming rig, it included a Photoshopped portrait of Pepe the Frog dressed as a Roman gladiator on the wall behind his desk.
paragraphs.zh: 当他发布了一张自己带有游戏装备的政府效率部办公室照片时 ，照片里他办公桌后面的墙上有一张经过ps处理过的青蛙佩佩扮成罗马角斗士的画像。

paragraphs.en: This was Kekius Maximus, an alias that Musk used in two of his favourite video games, Path of Exile 2 and Diablo 4, which he played while conceiving of and implementing Doge.
paragraphs.zh: 这就是凯基乌斯·马克西姆斯，这是马斯克在他最喜欢的两款电子游戏《流放之路2》和《暗黑破坏神4》中使用的别名，他在构思和推出政府效率部期间玩过这两款游戏。

paragraphs.en: Both games belong to a subgenre known as "dungeon crawlers".
paragraphs.zh: 这两款游戏都属于被称为“地下城探险类”的子类型。

paragraphs.en: You navigate labyrinthine environments filled with monsters, and descend deeper into dangerous areas, facing waves of attacks by enemy swarms, clearing one room after another by slaying all occupants.
paragraphs.zh: 你在布满怪物的迷宫般环境中穿行，深入到更危险的区域，面对敌群一波又一波的攻击，通过斩杀所有敌人来逐个清理房间。

paragraphs.en: It is easy to see how such games may have informed his mindset. He had already cleansed Twitter of wokeness.
paragraphs.zh: 不难看出这类游戏是如何影响他的思维方式的。他已经清除了推特上的“觉醒意识”。

paragraphs.en: Now he would enter the dungeons of Washington DC and slay what he called the "the woke parasite in the government".
paragraphs.zh: 现在，他要闯入华盛顿特区的“地牢”，铲除他所谓的“政府里的觉醒派寄生虫”。
